reference: Own python implementation of the ASHRAE Handbook-Fundamentals (2017) Ch.1 moist-air formulation (Hyland-Wexler saturation pressure Eq.5/6, humidity ratio Eq.20, enthalpy Eq.30, specific volume Eq.26, thermodynamic wet bulb Eq.33 above / Eq.35 below freezing, standard atmosphere Eq.3), cross-checked point by point against CoolProp 8.0.0 HAPropsSI (ASHRAE RP-1485 real-gas formulation).  Altitude conversion additionally checked against the ISA barometric formula derived from first principles.
reference_citations: Hyland, R.W. and Wexler, A. (1983), "Formulations for the Thermodynamic Properties of the Saturated Phases of H2O from 173.15 K to 473.15 K", ASHRAE Transactions 89(2A), 500-519.
CoolProp 8.0.0 HumidAirProp (Herrmann, Kretzschmar, Gatley - ASHRAE RP-1485 real-gas moist air).
ICAO Standard Atmosphere / ISO 2533:1975 troposphere barometric formula.
tolerance: per quantity, max(absolute display floor, relative): d 0.006 g/kg | 2e-3, i 0.012 kJ/kg | 1e-3, t_wb and t_dp 0.06 K, v 6e-4 m3/kg | 1e-3, phi 0.6 %, p_v 0.6 Pa | 2e-3, process power 0.02 kW | 3e-3, altitude->pressure 1e-4 relative.  The absolute parts are the half-ulp of the printed digits. A quantity whose ASHRAE-ideal vs CoolProp-real-gas reference spread exceeds its tolerance is flagged and not graded.
skipped_note: A skipped case has no graded criterion and is recorded with its reason under cases[].skipped; it is shown as flagged, never as a pass.
